page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance engineered for CPU-intensive computing tasks. Powered by x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, the instance features 104 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory. The resource ratio yields approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU, reflecting a compute-dense configuration intended for processing environments where CPU capacity takes priority over memory size.

The server operates on the KVM hypervisor and incorporates a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The configuration includes zero local ephemeral storage and features no discrete GPU hardware acceleration. Workloads running on this instance rely on network-attached storage solutions for all operating system and persistent data requirements.

From a cost efficiency perspective, the high vCPU core density offers multi-threaded processing power without forcing allocation costs for excess memory capacity. Key tradeoffs include the absence of onboard SSD storage and a lower memory-to-core ratio compared to general-purpose or memory-optimized families. Recommended workload fits include batch processing pipelines, high-concurrency web backends, scientific simulations, software compilation, and electronic design automation.
